title: Nil Ratan Kundu v. Abhijit Kundu

content.caseIdentity: Nil Ratan Kundu v. Abhijit Kundu, (2008) 9 SCC 413
content.facts: The Supreme Court considered a dispute requiring interpretation of the governing family-law provision or closely connected statutory rule.
questionsBeforeCourt: What is the correct legal interpretation and application of the governing statutory rule?
content.ratioDecidendi: Child welfare is the first and paramount consideration; parental or formal legal claims remain subordinate to that welfare assessment.
content.holding: Child welfare is the first and paramount consideration; parental or formal legal claims remain subordinate to that welfare assessment.
content.relevance: Use this authority for the stated statutory proposition, while matching the case facts and the current statutory text before relying on it.

evidence.note: Supreme Court of India (2008) 9 SCC 413; 2008 INSC 905; welfare of child paramount consideration in Guardians and Wards Act.
